item.title: Berkeley man shot while checking his car alarm
item.description: Right before Thanksgiving three years ago, Manasseh Kimbrough heard his car alarm out front. He simply opened his front door to look.

item.title: 68-year-old missing after telling wife he was stuck in snowstorm
item.description: According to officials, the wife of Ray Anthony Couch last heard from him on Monday, Jan. 26, in which he contacted her, saying that he was stuck in a snowstorm.

item.title: Tonia Haddix of 'Chimp Crazy' files appeal over prison sentence
item.description: Tonia Haddix, a Missouri woman featured on HBO Max's "Chimp Crazy" for her controversial ownership and care of chimpanzees, was sentenced to nearly four years in federal prison last year. Now, her attorneys are trying to appeal the sentence.

item.title: Suspect in St. Louis double fatal shooting, arson case found in Poplar Bluff
item.description: A month-long manhunt has ended with the arrest of a man charged in the killings of a St. Louis woman and her 9-year-old daughter.

item.title: Burst pipe closes small business in Potosi
item.description: A burst water main line has left a Potosi clothing and accessory boutique store in turmoil.

item.title: Mother seeks answers after son dies in NYE shooting
item.description: Police say this case became St. Louis' last homicide of 2025, and now, the victim's mother is breaking her silence, as she urges anyone with information to come forward.

item.title: Shooting inside Ferguson mortuary; multiple injuries reported
item.description: What was supposed to be a final goodbye ended in fear and confusion, as multiple people were hospitalized following a shooting at a Ferguson mortuary during a funeral.

item.title: Endangered Person Advisory issued for 16-year-old girl: SLCPD
item.description: An Endangered Person Advisory has been issued for a teenager who left her home Wednesday night and has not been seen since.

item.title: Overnight crash leaves hundreds without power in Maplewood
item.description: A single-vehicle crash in Maplewood caused a power outage for nearly 300 customers and left one person injured after striking a utility pole.
